fields.label: National ID
fields.description: The patient's national ID (card number), copied from the Patient record through the Patient Field Map in State Treatment Settings. Required before the request leaves Draft.

fields.label: Recommendation No.
fields.description: The official number of this recommendation. Required before the request leaves Draft.

fields.label: Recommendation Date
fields.description: The official date of this recommendation. Required before the request leaves Draft.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Under Committee Review
Administrative Letter
Recommendation Approved
File Reviewed at Hospital
Approved for Disbursement
Rejected
Treatment Completed
fields.description: Current stage in the approval workflow. Moves forward only through the workflow buttons.

fields.label: Admin Reviewer
fields.description: Name of the administrative reviewer who signed this request.

fields.label: Medical Reviewer
fields.description: Name of the medical reviewer who signed this request.

fields.label: General Manager
fields.description: Name of the General Manager who signed this request.

fields.label: Protocol Items
fields.description: One row for each treatment item from the protocol catalog. Required before the request leaves Draft. Medicine rows also need a First Dose Date before final approval.

fields.label: Total Amount
fields.description: Sum of the rates of all protocol items, in EGP. Calculated automatically.

fields.label: Treatment Summary
fields.description: Summary of dispensed doses and performed procedures. Filled automatically once the request is approved for disbursement.

fields.label: Treatment Dose Schedule
fields.description: Doses created automatically from the medicine rows in Protocol Items. Treatment Pharmacists tick each dose here when it is dispensed.
